outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer and aligns its gripper with the silver handle (frames 30–77, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its interior and yellow contents (frames 88–104, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws (frames 108–153, wrist_image and image); the drawer remains visibly open through frame 170 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
